description: This file defines a password dialog component for the Notesnook project, including its properties, rendering logic, validation, and display functions. It manages user input for passwords and optional checks, and handles validation and error display.

classes.name: PasswordDialog
classes.description: A React component registered with DialogManager that renders a password input dialog with validation and optional checks.

methods.name: showPasswordDialog
methods.description: Function to display the password dialog and return a promise resolving to the password or checks.
